description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_XHTMLAndHTML4, which extends HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy, and implements the makeFixes() method. The method returns an array of transformations for deprecated HTML tags and attributes, converting them into CSS styles or other modern equivalents, to aid in sanitizing and cleaning HTML content.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_XHTMLAndHTML4
classes.description: A class extending HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy that provides transformations for converting deprecated HTML tags and attributes into modern CSS styles as part of HTML sanitization.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Creates and returns an array of tag and attribute transformations to handle deprecated HTML elements and attributes, ensuring compatibility and isolating the transformations needed for XHTML and HTML4 standards.
